items.summary: Extend the professional studio posture into long-tail project, legal/support, and journal surfaces with a regression gate.
items.why: The main wayfinding pages now feel like a professional studio, but project detail and policy/support pages can still read like older isolated pages. A narrow content contract keeps the brand anchor from drifting back into page-by-page patchwork.
items.recipe: Add a `scripts/check-longtail-studio-posture.mjs` gate for representative long-tail pages, update the targeted copy where it fails, and wire the gate into `build:check`.

items.summary: Promote the inline-style extraction utility from a one-off mutator into a supported maintenance tool.
items.why: `scripts/extract-inline-styles.mjs` did useful work in S169, but it currently writes immediately, targets only seven intelligence pages, and has no check mode. That makes future cleanup harder to trust and pushes agents toward hand edits or accidental churn.
items.recipe: Add `--check`, `--list-targets`, and explicit target validation to `scripts/extract-inline-styles.mjs`; document the supported workflow in `docs/STUDIO_THEME_EVOLUTION_SYSTEM.md`.

items.summary: Reconcile public AI disclosures with the current local-first Ask IGNIS path and paid/capability-gated AI surfaces.
items.why: Privacy and terms still say Ask IGNIS forwards prompts to Anthropic by default, while the current public search/oracle path includes a static cited answer engine. That mismatch is both a trust issue and a token-cost story left untold.
items.recipe: Update `/privacy/` and `/terms/` AI sections to distinguish local cited retrieval from gated model-backed features, and add a tiny drift gate that fails if the old blanket Anthropic claim returns.

items.summary: Apply the new immersive studio primitives to representative long-tail pages instead of leaving them as unused design-system inventory.
items.why: S169 created `.vs-immersive-band`, `.vs-section-kicker`, `.vs-signal-grid`, and `.vs-proof-note`; the current HTML usage scan shows they exist in CSS but not in public pages. The primitives become real only when long-tail pages inherit the studio rhythm.
items.recipe: Adopt the primitives on at least one project detail page and one legal/support page, then extend `check-studio-theme-evolution.mjs` so usage is verified outside CSS/docs.

skipped.reason: Still data-gated by `api/nav-sheet-stats.json`; current startup signals show it is not ready.
Still requires Cloudflare KV soak evidence before enforcement; shipping blind would violate the security non-negotiable.

executionLog.summary: Added `--check`, `--list-targets`, and `--targets=` validation to `scripts/extract-inline-styles.mjs`, then documented the supported workflow in `docs/STUDIO_THEME_EVOLUTION_SYSTEM.md`.
Added `scripts/check-longtail-studio-posture.mjs`, wired it into `build:check`, and updated representative project, FAQ, policy, terms, and journal copy to carry the professional studio posture.

Updated privacy and terms copy to distinguish local cited retrieval from model-backed AI features, and added `scripts/check-ai-disclosure-alignment.mjs` to prevent the old blanket Anthropic claim from returning.
Applied studio primitives to `projects/vorn/index.html` and `privacy/index.html`, then extended `scripts/check-studio-theme-evolution.mjs` to verify long-tail primitive usage.
